headline: Housing Price Index Turns Down Again: Taichung City's Annual Decline Reaches 6.17%; Kaohsiung City Has Highest Quarterly Decline - Liberty Finance
summary: Taiwan's national housing price index fell 1.15% quarter on quarter and 3.48% year on year in the first quarter. Only Taipei City rose among the six special municipalities, by 0.45% quarterly.
why: Housing prices shape household wealth, mortgage credit quality and construction activity, and they feed into central bank and regulatory policy decisions.
